items.title: AI Citation drift: How stable are sources in AI search results?
items.summary:
A source cited in an AI response today may well have disappeared by next week. Our analysis of 82,619 prompts over 17 weeks shows that Google replaces 56% of sources in AI-generated responses every week, whilst ChatGPT replaces as much as 74%. In this article, we will explain who stays, […] 
 Der Beitrag  AI Citation drift: How stable are sources in AI search results?  erschien zuerst auf  SISTRIX .
